purpose: Define integrity, decryptability, completeness and optional restore-test verification over an exact backup artifact/set.

topics.name: Backup Verification
topics.purpose: Define integrity, decryptability, completeness and optional restore-test verification over an exact backup artifact/set.

semantics.restore_rule: Restore test occurs in exact sandbox/test target unless production restore is separately authorized.
semantics.expiry_rule: Verification evidence is bound to exact backup revision.
semantics.authority_rule: Valid backup does not authorize restore.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.

hard_gates.condition: restore test uses production target implicitly
old verification reused after backup mutation
